name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's fascination with motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent tinkering with engines in his grandfather's garage. This early exposure fueled his passion, leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, he joined a small racing team as a junior engineer, quickly impressing his superiors with his meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.

Over the years, Jean-Pierre honed his skills, working his way up the ranks to become a technical director. He is known for his data-driven approach and his ability to identify subtle performance gains. His dedication to precision and his visionary approach to problem-solving make him a valuable asset to any team, ensuring the car is in optimal condition for every race. At Walkenhorst, he's focused on integrating sustainable materials into the racing program.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A lean man with a focused gaze and a perpetual air of intensity.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Belgian coffee before every race.
